messages:
Asha: Quick question for the room — if you could pick one micro-superpower that only works in the morning (before coffee), what would it be? No world-saving, just tiny wins: think 'socks always match' or 'keys vibrate when you're late'.
Liam: Instantly made bed every time I open my bedroom door. 2 seconds, perfectly tucked. :bed:
Jordan: Brainless breakfast appears on the counter. Toast + egg + something green. No cleanup. :drooling_face:
Priya: Keys emit a soft glow when I'm running late. Also a polite nudge. :key: :alarm_clock:
Marco: Five-more-minutes that are actually five minutes (no slow-motion time war between snooze and reality). :clock3:
Sam: My hair does exactly what I want. Like, humidity-proof, combable-once kind of power. :sparkles:
coffee-bot: Lobby coffee update: 92°C, 3 cups ready. Automated espresso line available in 3 minutes. :coffee:
Liam: Also, 'fresh hot coffee materializes in my hand as I step out' micro-power would be revolutionary. :hand:
Priya: @Liam dangerous but also persuasive. I'd sign that form. :sweat_smile:
Jordan: Tally (emoji reactions): :thumbsup: x4, :heart: x1, :laughing: x1 — bed and coffee are leading.
Asha: Love the practical energy. Noting down quintessential Redwood priorities: bed, coffee, keys, hair. :raised_hands:
Marco: Follow-up — fun hypothetical: would you trade a classic superpower for your chosen micro-morning one for a week? thumbs-up = yes, thumbs-down = no.
Sam: No way I'm trading hair-power for flying. I'd probably fly into a tree.
Liam: Depends on whether airport security accepts my coffee-in-hand as a carry-on. :airplane:
Asha: Thread conclusion: tiny conveniences > grand gestures (for at least this morning). Thanks all for the energy — this was cheerfully practical 😂
